summary: Land acquisition lapse under Section 24(2) of Right to Fair Compensation Act, 2013; acquittal based on overruled precedent (Pune Municipal Corp.); Constitution Bench ruling (Indore Development Authority) clarifies lapse requires neither possession nor compensation; physical possession taken in 2006; acquisition valid despite non-payment of compensation; delay condonation in appeal granted due to public purpose utilization; compensation under 2013 Act not applicable.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.24(2)
final_judgment: Delay condoned; appellant entitled to compensation determined under 1894 Act award; High Court direction for 2013 Act compensation set aside.
